clips.title: The story
paras: The Barrel of Thunder Ale is a prized keg of Kharanos's signature brew, smuggled straight out of the Thunderbrew Distillery's cellar. Swapped out for a cask of Marleth's Barleybrew Scalder, it serves as undeniable proof of foul play in an escalating brewing rivalry.

In Dun Morogh, competition between rival master brewers runs deep, and few disputes are fiercer than the feud between the Thunderbrews of Kharanos and the Barleybrews of Brewnall Village. Marleth Barleybrew sought to slip a barrel of his own Barleybrew Scalder into his rivals' cellar, so that the Thunderbrews' patrons would taste his brew over theirs. This heavy barrel of Thunder Ale was seized in the exchange, dragged out under the noses of the local guards as physical evidence that the switch succeeded.
